message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is normally **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
During daylight‑saving periods the offset changes:

| Period | Los Angeles | Berlin | Difference |
|--------|-------------|--------|------------|
| Standard Time (roughly early November – mid-March) | UTC−08:00 | UTC+01:00 | Berlin is +9 h |
| Daylight Saving Time (mid-March – early November) | UTC−07:00 | UTC+02:00 | Berlin is +10 h |

So if it’s noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9 pm in Berlin during standard time, and 10 pm during daylight‑saving time.
